items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 18 at 3:31PM EDT until October 20 at 1:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35
knots and seas 10 to 14 feet.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm
and Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 20-60 nm.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
